settings.title: 90-Day Warranty
settings.subtitle: Every pair of Barreletics is backed by a 90-day warranty against manufacturing defects.
settings.international_text:
International customers do not need to return the original pair. Send a photo of the defect to our support team. If the claim is approved, the customer covers shipping and any duties on the replacement pair.

This process is faster and more cost-effective than international returns for both parties.

settings.text: Material splitting or cracking (not from misuse)
Damage from use on abrasive or unintended surfaces
Fit preference or sizing issues (see our exchange policy)

settings.title: Contact Support
settings.description: Email our support team with your order number and a description of the issue.

settings.title: Send Photos
settings.description: Include clear photos showing the defect. Close-up and full-product shots help us assess quickly.

settings.title: We Review
settings.description: Our team reviews your claim within 2-3 business days and responds with next steps.

settings.title: Resolution
settings.description: Approved claims receive a replacement pair. Domestic shipping is covered. International customers cover shipping and duties on the replacement.
